description: This file implements a class 'AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator' for handling Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming responses from the Bedrock AgentCore. It provides both synchronous and asynchronous iteration over SSE streams, parsing received lines into structured 'ModelResponse' objects, and managing stream completion signals.

classes.name: AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for handling server-sent events (SSE) streaming responses from the Bedrock AgentCore. Supports both sync and async iteration, parsing raw SSE lines into structured model responses, and managing stream lifecycle including termination signals.

methods.name: __init__(self, response: httpx.Response, model: str)
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with an HTTP response object and model identifier, setting up internal state for iteration.

methods.name: __iter__(self)
methods.description: Prepares and returns the synchronous iterator, lazily initializing the line iterator.

methods.name: __aiter__(self)
methods.description: Prepares and returns the asynchronous iterator, lazily initializing the async line iterator.

methods.name: Optional[ModelResponse] _parse_sse_line(self, line: str)
methods.description: Parses a single SSE line into a 'ModelResponse' object if the line contains relevant data, handling content deltas, metadata (including usage), and final messages.

methods.name: ModelResponse _create_final_chunk(self)
methods.description: Creates a 'ModelResponse' chunk that signals the end of the stream.

methods.name: ModelResponse __next__(self)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous iteration step, parsing incoming lines and yielding 'ModelResponse' objects until stream completion.

methods.name: ModelResponse __anext__(self)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous iteration step, parsing incoming lines and yielding 'ModelResponse' objects until stream completion.
